annotations.title: Estimate when a TIE card is ready

description: Whether a TIE card with a given lote number is ready for pickup at a specific office. The expected pickup window, its basis and the progress chart are on the linked tiehoy.com page.

lang.description: Language of the returned page links. Default en.

lote_number.description: The lote number (0–999) printed on the fingerprint receipt.

office.description: Office name or part of it. If several match, the tool lists them.
